_comment: Release manifest. Every Hub with update checks on fetches this file and compares its own version against `version`. Bump it as part of cutting a release, not before - the harness pins it equal to package.json so a manifest that lies about the current release cannot ship.
notes: 2.23.2: a Dispatch job whose file was deleted from the library is now flagged on the row, the next-print handoff explains it instead of opening an empty dashboard, and the library refuses to delete a file an open job still needs. 2.23.1: more colors than heads works when the gcode carries a pause. 2.23 was the speed release: dashboard and Dispatch load in well under a second on a big farm, a paused print says why, and the Dispatch badge shows a spool glyph.
